module: Edge detection for edge-based anti-aliasing. Creates the state block PFX_DefaultEdgeAAStateBlock, the shader PFX_EdgeAADetectShader (edgeDetect.cs.hlsl) and the PostEffect "EdgeDetectPostEffect" (enabled, resolution 0.5x0.5, target #edge, before ObjTranslucentBin) which reads #prepass[RT0] and the depth. No exported function.
